title: How Wuxi AppTec Stayed Sanction-Proof

How Wuxi AppTec Stayed Sanction-Proof

Tom Hancock

Gavekal Technologies: Briefing | 2 Nov 2026

China’s two “Wuxi” biotech firms—AppTec and Biologics—are key partners for the US pharmaceutical industry, as contract developers and manufacturers of hundreds of thousands of chemical compounds. They combine near cutting-edge technology with unmatched process knowledge, strong supply chain control, and robust intellectual-property protection. Washington lawmakers are increasingly uneasy about rising American reliance on the Wuxi firms. But their efforts to curb Wuxi’s access to the US market have been blocked, thanks to strong lobbying by the US pharma and biotech industries, which see collaboration with Chinese contract drug research firms as essential to their own success.Also in this issue of China Tech Brief:
